title: Hymn of Hope Season 1
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
79 players signed up for [[Hymn of Hope Season 1]]. It was the first of its kind in a long time to include cash money for the top spots, which also made sure it got some attention from other big gaming sites. Hymn of Hope was originally an initiative by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Zingao]], who did a great job promoting this tournament, and gather together a nice team of people to administrate it. The tournament would run over 2 days, where the majority of the games were played on the first day, and the finals were played on the second.

* Running date: 14th - 15th of April [[2012]]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/hoh #HoH] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: [http://hymnofhope.tourney.cc/ Hymn of Hope Season 1]

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[ztndm3]], [[aerowalk]]
* Allowed clients: [[FTEQW]] 1.00, [[FodQuake]] 0.2 or 0.3 and [[ezQuake]] 2.0 or 2.1 with -ruleset smackdown
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
* Ktpro spawns. (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77.
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
